name: cat-kitty-edition
description: Stable 1.0.0 release: privacy-first browser ad filtering, conservative rule handling, filter preview, rollback, and release checks.

scripts.test:all: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v && node --check src/background/service-worker.js && node --check src/detector/detector.js && node --check src/cleaner/cleaner.js && node --check src/kitty-ui/options.js && node --check src/kitty-ui/popup.js && node tests/test_runtime_contracts.js && python release_gate.py
scripts.verify:release: python build_extension.py all && npm run test:all
